newsitem.title: YEMEN: German family safe after launch capsizes off Yemen.
newsitem.headline: German family safe after launch capsizes off Yemen.

text.p: Yemeni fishermen have rescued a German family of four after their launch capsized near the southern port city of Aden because of bad weather and heavy rain, security sources said on Sunday.

The German couple and their two children aged 11 and 13 were sailing in the Gulf of Aden on Saturday afternoon after leaving Djibouti when their vessel began to overturn because of strong winds 65 km (40 miles) east of Aden.
Yemeni fishermen who were in the area immediately went to their rescue and safely escorted them to port, one source told Reuters. He did not identify the Germans.
The police chief in the nearby Abyan governorate visited the family and offered them help.
